verdict.rationale: The docs say API credentials are generated under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where users can configure each credential's permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint references name specific permissions (e.g., "Monitor and unmonitor customers", "View roles in account"), which points to fine-grained, per-operation scoping suitable for least-privilege agent credentials. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on credential permission granularity and role assignment, programmatic or API-based credential issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that scoping is enforced.
